d.ko:
Your aunt’s dead, your cousin hates you, and you’re stuck in the dead-end town of Scarlet Hollow.

Choose your path through a branching narrative so dense that you'll see less than 1/5 of the game on a single playthrough. You won't be able to save everyone. Good luck, and welcome home.

Scarlet Hollow is an incredible experience. The developers are frankly insane, the amount of work put into the writing and the artwork and the branching storylines is just bonkers. …
you're on a path in the woods, and at the end of the path, lies a mansion. and in that mansion, is your estranged cousin. your job is to survive the next seven days. good luck!
I can’t recommend this game after episode 5. I purchased it in 2022 and waited a long time for episode 5 to be released. I played the game for over 30 hours, explored all traits and all routes. …
没有官方中文，B站up"小似睡非睡"制作了汉化包，感谢她，游玩体验好太多了。 开局选的不同体质可以影响后续探索选项，很喜欢这种元素。游戏分支很多，渗人氛围营造的很好。 缺点是剧情未完结！ …
